title: UserPostsOutput
description: The JSON document produced by the user-posts command after collection starts.

status.description: Whether the available pages were exhausted, the CLI limit stopped collection, or an error stopped collection.

incomplete_reason.description: Why collection stopped early. Present only when status is incomplete.

target_user.description: The requested X user and, after successful resolution, their upstream identity.

retrieved_at.description: UTC time at which this collection run started.

post_count.description: Number of posts retained; equals the length of posts.

posts.description: Posts returned by X, including posts without external links. Always an array.

id.description: Upstream user identifier; omitted when username resolution failed.

name.description: Upstream display name; omitted when username resolution failed.

username.description: Username requested by the caller, normalized without a leading @ after resolution.

start_time.description: RFC 3339 inclusive lower time bound sent to X.

end_time.description: RFC 3339 exclusive upper time bound sent to X.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts retained by the CLI.

url.description: Canonical x.com URL for the post.

text.description: Long-form text when supplied by X, otherwise the regular post text.

created_at.description: Upstream created_at value; empty if X omits it.
